en.title: SR footnotes: in 4 articles one language version cites the AS entry of a different act
en.summary: In 4 articles of 3 acts of the Classified Compilation (SR), the footnotes of all language versions describe the same amending act, but in one version the reference to the Official Compilation (AS) is that of a different act. Each finding was read in the PDF of the consolidated version, which is the authoritative form. Which language version is right is not decided here.
en.impact: A reader who follows the footnote of one language version reaches a different entry of the Official Compilation than readers of the other versions, or none. No effect on the content of the provisions has been established.
en.correction: The Federal Chancellery decides how to correct each place; the evidence gives the wording of each language version.

de.title: SR-Fussnoten: In 4 Artikeln verweist eine Sprachfassung auf die AS-Fundstelle eines anderen Erlasses
de.summary: In 4 Artikeln aus 3 Erlassen der Systematischen Rechtssammlung (SR) beschreiben die Fussnoten aller Sprachfassungen denselben Änderungserlass; in einer Fassung ist die Fundstelle der Amtlichen Sammlung (AS) jedoch die eines anderen Erlasses. Jeder Befund wurde im PDF der konsolidierten Fassung gelesen, das massgebend ist. Welche Sprachfassung zutrifft, legen wir nicht fest.

fr.title: Notes du RS : dans 4 articles, une version linguistique renvoie à l'entrée RO d'un autre acte
fr.summary: Dans 4 articles de 3 actes du Recueil systématique (RS), les notes de toutes les versions linguistiques décrivent le même acte modificateur, mais dans une version la référence au Recueil officiel (RO) est celle d'un autre acte. Chaque constat a été lu dans le PDF de la version consolidée, qui fait foi. Nous ne déterminons pas quelle version linguistique est exacte.

it.title: Note della RS: in 4 articoli una versione linguistica rinvia alla voce RU di un altro atto
it.summary: In 4 articoli di 3 atti della Raccolta sistematica (RS), le note di tutte le versioni linguistiche descrivono lo stesso atto modificatore, ma in una versione il riferimento alla Raccolta ufficiale (RU) è quello di un altro atto. Ogni constatazione è stata letta nel PDF della versione consolidata, che è determinante. Non stabiliamo quale versione linguistica sia corretta.

ai_role.en: AI agents wrote and ran checks over the Classified Compilation of Federal Legislation, read each finding in the PDF of the consolidated version and had it read again by a second AI reader; the coordinator of the checks decided each finding.
